text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's still some time before training.
But just as
I sit down to review my data...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdyyy, Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You should've seen the look on your
face! Guess
my little surprise was a
success!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I knew ya wouldn't expect me outside of
training
hours...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I sped on over when your guard was
down,
and—bang! Bull's-eye!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Job well done, if I do say so
myself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is that really all she came here to do? I
ask if she
has another reason for
visiting...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: As a matter of fact, I do! I wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh... What was it again?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh well,
ya know how it goes! I'll just ask
ya when
it comes back to me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, since I'm here... How about
gettin' an
early start on training?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My debut's right around the corner, so
don't try
and stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle drags me to the track, with
our
training session starting well ahead
of schedule...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hm-hmm, I'm on my way... Me and
Trainer
off to the racetrack... ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, who's that I spy over there?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy there, Air Groooove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You again, Taiki? How many times do I
have to
tell you not to tackle me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Sorry 'bout that! You never seem
to budge,
so I can't resist tryin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Guess I gotta give it a bit more oomph
next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You just don't know when to quit, do
you?!
You've got some nerve...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... At any rate, have you settled everything with your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you've got permission, let's get
started.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Right... Permission. Uh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you've forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to be moving all the
Umamusume
of the Year resources over
to the library!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You said you needed to ask your trainer
to adjust
your training schedule first and
ran off!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, so that's what it was!
It's all comin'
back to
me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's because I just explained
everything to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel a little bad leaving things this
way, so I
decide to lend a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! There're more papers here than ya
can
shake a stick at! Even with all three
of us, we're
nowhere near finished!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Considering they concern every single

Umamusume of the Year since the title's

inception, it's understandable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
These materials contain not only their
individual performance records, but
detailed accounts of
their training
regimens and opponents as well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be darned! That's those
Umamusume of
the Year for ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...What exactly is an "Umamusume of the
Year,"
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You don't even know that?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... Every year, a select number
of runners from the Twinkle Series are
bestowed a URA award to commemorate
their outstanding
performance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The awards are divided into several
divisions, including one for classic-year
runners, as well as
others for sprints and
dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But only a single runner—one whose efforts
outshine all the others—can
receive the honor of
Umamusume of the
Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So basically... we're talkin' about a
super
amazing Umamusume here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the title has historically gone
to
powerhouses with overwhelming
talent... but
that's not the whole story.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whaddya mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The winners are preserved here in
writing, their
names passed down for
generations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The stage of the Twinkle Series dazzles
with tales
of past greats, ever woven
into its history.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mesmerized by its glamor, everyone
longs to
stand on its turf.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To become a presence that ignites a
burning passion into the hearts of
others—that's what it
means to be an
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish collating the materials,
Taiki and I
head out to train...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Guess what! I heard resources about all
the
previous Umamusume of the Year
have been
added to the library!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What, seriously? We should go have a
look, like,
right now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you all about who inspired me to
get into
running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What a nice smile that was. Shinin' so
bright.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You said it!
choice_data_list: It was full of dreams, wasn't it?
It was so full of dreams, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just by steppin' on the track, you can
find your
dream...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And nothing makes us Umamusume or
our fans
happier!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, that settles it! I know what I
gotta do!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become Umamusume of the
Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never expected to hear these words.
It's a statement that could easily be
mistaken for any
one of her usual
offbeat remarks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the glint in Taiki Shuttle's eyes
tells
me
otherwise. This time, she's serious.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can see it now—fantastic races, great

performances!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's what I wanna show everybody...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Everybody" bein' my peers, fans, family, and friends! Everybody I know, and everybody I ever will know!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make every single last one of
'em as
happy as possible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's fiery passion burns bright...
and I
won't shy
away from it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah! I'm markin' the title of
Umamusume of
the Year as my new
target!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a grand dream in her sights, Taiki
Shuttle
takes her very first step forward!
